name: B10-0215/2026 (PPE) – Ensuring accountability and justice in response to Russia’s continued attacks against the civilian population in Ukraine
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on ensuring accountability and justice in response to Russia’s continued attacks against the civilian population in Ukraine
part_text:
The European Parliament calls on Russia to stop all attacks on Ukrainian civilians and to withdraw its forces from Ukraine. It asks the European Union to set up a delegation in The Hague to work with international courts, to join the new tribunal for Russia's crime of aggression, and to join the International Claims Commission for Ukraine. It also calls for personal sanctions on Russian officials responsible for torturing detained Ukrainians, and says Russia must pay for the damage it caused. This is a statement of the Parliament's position, not a change in law.

- The European Union is asked to open a delegation in The Hague and join new accountability bodies.
- The European Union is asked to sanction Russian officials blamed for torture of detained Ukrainians.
- The Parliament wants Russia to pay for war damage; it will monitor the new 90 billion euro loan to Ukraine.
